name: Mazagon Dock

snapshot.about: Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders Limited builds and repairs warships, submarines, and commercial ships.

narrative: Management projected steady top-line growth and stable margins, which aligned reasonably well with actual revenue expansion. However, cash generation diverged significantly from reported profits, with operating cash flows remaining weak despite positive bottom-line figures.
